extracted.name: Kiwiriqui
extracted.description: Green fruit works really well with mezcal and this cocktail shows just that, combining the smoky spirit with kiwi, apple and lime
ingredient_lines: ½ kiwi plus a slice to garnish
instruction_lines: Add the kiwi half, kiwi liqueur, agave syrup and lime juice to the bottom of a cocktail shaker and muddle together. Add the rest of the ingredients and shake together.
Strain into a rocks glass filled with fresh ice and garnish with a slice of kiwi.
